status: Release candidate. Hosted desktop, package and advisory checks qualify the final revision before publication.
changes: Use native GTK editing for Arabic Markdown in Source and the editable side of Split when Linux WebKitGTK misplaces Arabic diacritics.
Use the bundled Amiri face for Arabic and retain live preview, undo, recovery, and exact-byte saves.
Resolve application shortcuts with the configured Latin mapping while the Arabic keyboard layout is active.

localLinux.candidateDesktop: The 90-test X11 suite passed on the GTK integration before the version bump. The locally packaged app accepted typed and pasted Arabic with the Arabic keyboard layout active and Ctrl+S preserved exact BOM and CRLF bytes.
localLinux.candidateWayland: Six focused Arabic reading and editing checks passed before the version bump under Weston, including the native GTK pane in Source and Split.

platforms: macOS universal app and ARM64 runtime
RPM extraction and Fedora 44 dependency installation
hostedCI.advisories: Production and full JavaScript audit; Rust audit including unsound and unmaintained warnings

Linux.buildBaseline: Ubuntu 24.04; GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1 and glibc 2.39 or newer
Linux.rpmRuntimeScope: Fedora 44 installation, package verification and native library resolution; no Fedora physical desktop qualification

manualUpdates.policy: No startup checks, automatic downloads, installation or restart; each step requires an explicit action.

channels.macOS: Pinned, version-bound signature; universal app archive; explicit install and restart.
channels.Linux: Pinned, version-bound signatures; matching DEB or RPM; OS installer approval and explicit version-checked restart.

manualUpdates.compatibility: latest.json retains exactly the original macOS and DEB platforms for 0.3.0 clients; RPM installations use latest-rpm.json.
manualUpdates.installedUpgradeQualification: Actual privileged DEB approval/restart and macOS replacement/restart require a controlled installed-release upgrade. Test fixtures never update this workstation.

remainingQualifications: WebKitGTK can still misplace some marks in Read, Visual, and the Split preview. Browser spellcheck and Find use the web editing surface. The engine issue is tracked at https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=255972.
Native Intel runtime and minimum-supported macOS verification; both universal slices compile and validate as desktop MACOS, while hosted runtime coverage is ARM64
Physical IME, screen-reader speech/navigation, keyboard/image integration, font dialogs, HiDPI and printing
Full installed Ubuntu desktop qualification; installed-package UI checks use isolated hosted and offline runtime desktops
Sustained large Source, multitab, Git/Review resource distributions and compositor/input-to-paint/DOM/IPC measurements
Broader filesystem/Git/storage/crash faults, converters/fonts/layout and tool-version combinations
Downloaded macOS opening/Gatekeeper and clean-machine channel verification
Actual installed-release update approval/replacement and restart on each supported OS; automated signature, cancellation and version-bound checks do not certify privileged OS installation.
Native Fedora desktop input and an actual installed RPM approval/upgrade/restart sequence; container dependency checks do not certify these.
evidencePolicy: Results apply only to their recorded executable, source, host and scope. Raw local traces and failed runs remain in ignored artifacts; maintained tests, provenance and legal notices remain in source. No ignored advisory, release evaluator or physical-input inference.
